name: alert-dialog
description: The confirm / destructive-action variant of `Dialog`, built on Radix Alert Dialog. Unlike `Dialog`, there is no dismiss-on-outside-click or Escape by default — the user must pick an action.

props.name: animate
props.description:
Backdrop fade, panel enter/exit, and border draw-in on open.
Defaults to the DoodleUIProvider value (true).

props.name: bowing
props.description: How much straight lines bow/curve in rough.js.

props.name: fillStyle
props.description: Fill pattern when the shape has a fill color.

props.name: fillWeight
props.description: Weight/thickness of individual hatch lines inside patterned fills.

props.name: hachureAngle
props.description: Angle in degrees of hatch lines for patterned fills.

props.name: hachureGap
props.description: Spacing between hatch lines for patterned fills.

props.name: roughness
props.description: Sketchiness intensity passed to rough.js. Higher values look messier.

props.name: seed
props.description: Locks the hand-drawn wobble. Omit to follow SketchSeedProvider or fixed-then-randomize.

props.name: sketchColor
props.description: Stroke (outline) color override. Falls back to theme ink.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Width of sketch strokes in pixels.

example:
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogTrigger,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogAction,
  Button,
} from "doodleui-react";

<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
    <Button variant="outline">Delete sketch</Button>
  </AlertDialogTrigger>
  <AlertDialogContent>
    <AlertDialogHeader>
      <AlertDialogTitle>Delete this sketch?</AlertDialogTitle>
      <AlertDialogDescription>This can't be undone.</AlertDialogDescription>
    </AlertDialogHeader>
    <AlertDialogFooter>
      <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
      <AlertDialogAction>Delete</AlertDialogAction>
    </AlertDialogFooter>
  </AlertDialogContent>
</AlertDialog>
